title: Athena JS — Type-Safe Infrastructure SDK for Data, Auth & Application Backends
description: Athena JS is a type-safe infrastructure SDK for building application backends across Node.js, browsers, React, React Native, Next.js, and Cloudflare. It provides a fluent SQL query API, direct and gateway-backed database access, embedded and remote authentication, authorization policies, migrations, organizations, billing, and runtime tooling behind one consistent TypeScript API.
